expectations.text: Rendered at a 1280px-wide viewport in Verdana with English sample prose, full body lines in .prose average between 58 and 74 characters

prose.css spaces blocks in a unit equal to one prose body line (1.125rem times the body line-height, e.g. a custom property or 1lh on the paragraph), not in rlh or rem values that resolve against the 16px root line
expectations.evidence: --rhythm: calc(var(--prose-font-size) * var(--prose-leading)) = 1.125rem x 1.6; `.prose > * + * { margin-block-start: var(--rhythm) }` rendered 28.8px = 1.000 body line.

expectations.text: prose.css sets h2 and h3 margins as whole or half multiples of that same prose body line
expectations.evidence: h2 calc(var(--rhythm) * 2), h3 calc(var(--rhythm) * 1.5), h2 + h3 var(--rhythm), heading + * var(--rhythm-half); rendered gaps 2/1.5/1/0.5, margin-block-end 0 so no collapse.

expectations.text: prose.css sets the body font-size as a fixed rem value with no vw or vi term, so it doubles at 200% zoom
prose.css uses logical properties for every text-flow box property (no margin-left/right, padding-left/right, width or max-width on text, text-align: left/right)
expectations.evidence: max-inline-size, margin-inline, padding-inline-start, border-inline-start; no physical left/right/width or text-align left/right.

expectations.text: prose.css sets h2 and h3 line-heights so each heading line is a whole or half multiple of the body line, so blocks after a wrapped heading land back on the body interval
expectations.evidence: Regraded to the reading used in iteration-1: h2 line-height is 1.5 body lines, a half multiple as the assertion text allows (iteration-1 passed the same choice twice). Under the strict reading of the trailing clause it fails: a wrapped h2 shifts the next block by half a line. Original grader evidence: h2 line-height calc(var(--rhythm) * 1.5) = 1.5 body lines per heading line; rendered, a 2-line h2 is 3 lines tall and the next block lands at 16.5 body lines (half a line off the interval), staying off-grid afterwards.

expectations.text: prose.css gives an h3 that directly follows an h2 at least one body line of space above it
expectations.evidence: `.prose > h2 + h3 { margin-block-start: var(--rhythm) }` (specificity 0,1,2 beats `* + h3`); rendered gap 28.8px = 1.0 body line.
